name: Classic N reasons

sources.name: The tenant's live reasons listicle (its listicle exemplar)

sections.hero: Dek: one plain line on what the product changes for this reader.
sections.items: Five reasons, each one feature stated as the benefit it buys the reader, with a proof line.
sections.closing: Recap three reasons; one CTA phrase throughout.

items.heading_hint: How simply it sets up (power, assembly)
How it fits the reader's space
How the reader runs it day to day
How it arrives and what backs it

voice: Plain, warm, second person, short sentences.
compliance: Every number, price, spec or outcome needs a verified claim_id; a hint is never a fact.
No health or outcome promise for the product; a health statement cites the study and its population.
The winner's trust line and customer count are patterns only: never copied unless verified.
writer_brief: Follow the tenant's winner: five short reasons, one feature each, stated as a benefit, each with a proof line. Do not pad.
